dedupe_keys.name: high quality data enabling universality of band gap descriptor and discovery of photovoltaic perovskites

description: High-quality data enabling universality of band-gap descriptor and discovery of photovoltaic perovskites is a dataset listed in Swiss national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Materials Cloud. Extensive machine-learning assisted research has been dedicated to predicting band gaps for perovskites, driven by their immense potential in photovoltaics. Yet, the effectiveness is often hampered by the lack of high-quality band-gap datasets, particularly for perovskites involving d orbitals. Coverage: Switzerland. The portal files it under the publisher Materials Cloud. The portal shows 2026-09-23 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-ch-portal.
